message.content:
The exact amount will vary with the day’s exchange rate, but as a rough guide:

| Currency | Approximate Rate (as of mid‑2024) | Equivalent |
|----------|----------------------------------|------------|
| 1 USD    | 0.77 GBP                         | 1 USD ≈ £0.77 |
| 20 USD   | –                                | 20 USD ≈ £15.40 |

So, **$20 is roughly £15–£16** today.  

> **Tip:** For the most accurate conversion, check a reliable financial news source or a currency‑conversion app right before you make a transaction, because rates can shift by a few pence in a single day.
